oral_examination.oral_examination: 1. The face is slightly asymmetrical from left to right, with the right cheek being plump; the upper and lower labia are protruding on the side; the mandibular joint mobility is normal on both sides, the opening is three fingers horizontally, the opening is toward the middle and lower, and there is no tenderness or snapping in the joint area; 2. The permanent dentition in the mouth, the maxillary and mandibular dental arches have rounded tips; 3. The right molar has a distal relationship, the left molar has a neutral relationship, the anterior teeth have a deep coverage of 4mm, a deep overbite, and the midlines of the upper and lower dentition are uneven; the upper and lower anterior teeth The lips are tilted; 4. Oral hygiene is average, and there is no obvious redness, swelling, abnormality or soft scale in the gums;
